abstract: Maintains non-destructive diagnostic setup status, flaw resolution metrics, and field screening capacity
system_message:
You are the Non-destructive testing specialist (NDT). Your role is to maintain non-destructive diagnostic setup status, flaw resolution metrics, and field screening capacity, as well as transducer calibration stability for pipeline rupture forensic investigations.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Transducer calibration stability（CALIB）
information_points.content:
NDT-CALIB-Q2O：Regarding transducer calibration stability, the Pulsed eddy current profiling and electron backscatter diffraction plan shows an ultrasonic transducer baseline drift rate of 0.08 %/month across on-site ultrasonic probe arrays.
NDT-CALIB-IAR：Regarding transducer calibration stability, the Digital micro-computed tomography and resonant acoustic spectroscopy plan reflects an ultrasonic transducer baseline drift rate of 0.02 %/month across on-site ultrasonic probe arrays.
NDT-CALIB-HP1：Regarding transducer calibration stability, the High-resolution phased-array ultrasonic and metallurgical replication plan demonstrates an ultrasonic transducer baseline drift rate of 0.05 %/month across on-site ultrasonic probe arrays.

information_points.title: Maintains non-destructive diagnostic setup status, flaw resolution metrics, and field screening capacity（SCAN）
information_points.content:
NDT-SCAN-LWY：For the High-resolution phased-array ultrasonic and metallurgical replication plan, the preliminary non-destructive testing protocol is enabled for initial on-site pipe spool scanning operations. Longitudinal weld seam flaw detection sensors achieve a defect detection resolution of 0.45 mm, and the mobile field screening throughput at the rupture site mobile diagnostic trailer is 16 samples/day.
NDT-SCAN-OSL：For the Pulsed eddy current profiling and electron backscatter diffraction plan, the preliminary non-destructive testing protocol is enabled for initial on-site pipe spool scanning operations. Longitudinal weld seam flaw detection sensors provide a defect detection resolution of 0.85 mm, and the mobile field screening throughput reaches 24 samples/day.
NDT-SCAN-CCF：For the Digital micro-computed tomography and resonant acoustic spectroscopy plan, the preliminary non-destructive testing protocol is enabled for initial on-site pipe spool scanning operations. The longitudinal weld seam flaw detection sensors provide a defect detection resolution of 0.45 mm, alongside a mobile field screening throughput of 24 samples/day.
